high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "close2science." The post features a poll asking viewers which lecture they would like to attend, with options for lectures by famous scientists and physicists. The poll includes six images, each representing a different scientist or physicist: Einstein: A black-and-white photo shows Albert Einstein giving a lecture to a group of students. Tesla: A black-and-white photo depicts Nikola Tesla working on some equipment, possibly in his laboratory.
